name: Riko
source:
The sprightliest, most straightforward, most energetic girl out there. Her excessive amount of energy always leads to her making mistakes, so Rentarou getting mad at her is just part of the daily routines. Though somewhat childish, she's frank and upfront about herself that you just can't hate her.

[Taken from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/a-butterfly-in-the-district-of-dreams/]Sekai Project[/url]]
